title: Ex-OpenAI Employee Accused of Bugging Company Offices Granted $1 Million Bail
content_md: A former OpenAI employee accused of concealing a covert recording device at the company's San Francisco offices will be allowed to be released from jail on a $1 million bond, a San Francisco federal court judge ruled Tuesday.
